title: Procore Explore: Test new features before they touch your jobsites
summary: Procore Explore is your internal innovation command center. It’s a dedicated pipeline inside Procore’s Company Admin—and you control the flow.
body_markdown:
Picture this: a beta feature drops, and you're not sure it's ready for every project you run. Do you skip it and risk falling behind? Roll it out everywhere and risk disrupting work in progress? With Procore Explore, you don't have to choose.


[Procore Explore](https://support.procore.com/products/online/user-guide/company-level/admin/tutorials/manage-features-with-procore-explore) gives you a direct hand in Procore’s product roadmap. Test early, tell us what works, and help decide what's ready for your company or the projects you choose.


### Procore Explore: Your internal innovation command center


Safely test, triage, and deploy cutting-edge features.


Get a single view of Procore early access, beta, and next-generation tools.


At the same time, get granular control so you can make strategic decisions about who gets access to what.


### **4 Steps to try new tech without missing a beat**


The goal: stay ahead of the curve without throwing your jobsites off their rhythm.


Here's how Explore keeps you in step, feature by feature:


1.


**Size up the options.** Check out Procore Explore's available beta features. Tag them as In Review, On Hold, or High Priority depending on your project and portfolio needs.


2.


**Run a controlled pilot.** Procore Explore gives you a way to neatly assign the beta to specific projects or users. That gives you flexibility. You can give tech-forward staff a complex task or try an intriguing feature on a low-risk job or sandbox project.


3.


**Compare notes.** Help to keep admins aligned by documenting internal feedback, pilot results, and configuration requirements in Admin Notes.


4.


**Scale with confidence.** Once a feature passes your field test, work with the Procore team to roll it out company-wide.


### **Procore Explore: The inside track**


The faster you test advanced technology, the bigger your opportunity to find where it delivers a real advantage. That’s true for your teams in the office and out in the field. Explore helps you get more out of the Procore platform instead of waiting to see what everyone else discovers first.


Construction technology, including AI, isn't slowing down. Testing early through Explore keeps your team ahead of that pace, shaping how new tools fit your business instead of being handed something built for someone else's.


Plus, with the latest tech, you help your company become the employer of choice for Millennial and Gen-Z talent. You hand them the high-tech tools they crave, and not broken-down legacy software or manual processes.


Start exploring Procore Explore today. You might pick one or two features to pressure-test on your next project. With controlled access, you get Procore's latest technology on your terms—and a head start on whatever comes next.


#### **Ready to start taking steps?**
